title: A2A structured handoff request
description: Issue #2050: structured handoff request contract for POST /api/a2a. source_event_seq is the source pipeline segment seq. Callers SHOULD send it explicitly (top-level preferred, payload.* accepted); when omitted the server derives it from the caller session (source task event_seq), keeping structured handoff the primary trigger source while text A2A lines remain a readable fallback.

source_event_seq.description: Source pipeline segment seq (top-level, preferred). Falls back to the caller session's event_seq server-side.
